name: 20170 · Herndon, VA
findings: ZIP 20170 (Herndon) has 197 nonprofit organizations. 90 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 73 organizations.
Research and think tank organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20170 (Herndon) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
